notes: All items realised in code. Caveats (still scored present): REF-BM-03 auto-collected title/description are fully editable via the editor and the create flow opens it, though editing happens after the immediate one-step save rather than in a pre-save preview. REF-BM-24 stores a single local .html file (or the PDF for PDF urls, satisfying the boundary rule) but injects a <base href> to the origin rather than inlining assets, so it is a single-file markup capture, not a fully self-contained offline archive. REF-BM-29 persists the bundle as one query string (which can embed #tag inclusion and NOT exclusion) rather than separate included/excluded tag fields, but the saved filter is reusable and matches live.
